info.title: YoutubeDownloadHelper engine API
info.description: Base URL and bearer token: the engine.json discovery file in the data folder.

get.summary: Engine and API versions, tools, login status and queue blocks. Also the health check.

post.summary: A video's metadata, or a playlist's or channel's entries (flat), each flagged when adding it would be a duplicate.
post.description: Runs yt-dlp; downloads nothing. A YouTube video URL resolves as a single video even when it names a playlist (list=). A channel URL without a tab lists its tabs as entries of kind playlist. 422 with the yt-dlp error (error.* code) when yt-dlp fails; 503 resolve.toolsMissing while yt-dlp is not installed.

post.summary: Pauses the whole queue: no download starts, running ones go back to the queue (partial files kept).

get.summary: Completed and skipped items, newest first.
get.description: search: matches title, channel or URL (ignoring case for ASCII letters). cursor: the nextCursor of the previous page. limit: page size (default 50, at most 500).

patch.summary: Changes the settings that are present in the body; all or nothing. Answers the new settings.

get.summary: Server-sent events: every change to the queue, the blocks and the tools, and notifications.
get.description: Each event has an id (the sequence number), an event name and one JSON object as data (see the Contracts EventTypes). Send Last-Event-ID (header, or the lastEventId query parameter) to get every later event; if they are no longer buffered, or without it, the stream starts with 'resync'. Comment lines are heartbeats. The stream ends after 'engine.stopping'.

post.summary: Stops the engine gracefully. Answers before it stops.

get.summary: The queue in order, with live progress, and the event sequence number it is consistent with.
get.description: state: comma-separated item states to keep. search: matches title, channel or URL (ignoring case). cursor: the nextCursor of the previous page. limit: page size (default 1000, at most 5000).

post.summary: Queues URLs or YouTube video IDs, with a result per input: added, duplicate or invalid.

get.summary: An item in the queue or in history, with its transitions, its yt-dlp runs and their output.

delete.summary: Removes an item from the queue or history. With deleteFiles=true its downloaded file is deleted too.

post.summary: Pauses an item; a running download stops and keeps its partial files.
Puts a paused item back in the queue.
Requeues a failed or waiting item, with its retry count reset.
Moves an item to the top, the bottom, or before another item.

bearer.description: The token from engine.json. Regenerated on every engine start.
